actual: On 2026-06-30 two MiniQMT SIM runs (L2 simrun_be0af928d096734b and L16 simrun_0143264657762a1e) are stuck in status=RECONCILING with last_stage=RECONCILING, broker_called=false, submitted_intents=0 while execution intents exist. Broker authoritative account 62266303 SIM has no orders, no cancelable orders, frozen_cash=0. L2 runtime-state still contains stale 2026-06-29 ACTIVE algo/child records while broker is empty. Scheduler does not resubmit no-side-effect RECONCILING runs, and RESET_STRATEGY_SLOT attempts broker cancel for stale order ids, xtquant returns raw_return_code=-1, so existing operator tooling cannot recover. Need a controlled operator recovery entry that fresh-reconciles broker authority, only when broker open orders are empty performs runtime-only terminalization of stale ACTIVE algo/child, and converts no-side-effect RECONCILING runs to FAILED_RETRYABLE for normal scheduler retry. All failures must be loud with reason_code and durable audit; existing CANCEL/RESET behavior for real orders must remain unchanged.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
